mapper.insert: insert into "ai_friend" (ai_friend_id, user_id, name, description, hobbies, characteristic, like_score, character_history) values( #{aiFriendId}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{hobbies}, #{characteristic}, #{likeScore}, #{characterHistory});
mapper.select: select ai_friend_id, user_id, name, header_image_addr, create_time, is_complete from "ai_friend" where user_id=#{userId} and is_delete=false limit #{need} offset #{start}

select ai_friend_id, user_id, name, description, hobbies, characteristic, like_score, header_image_addr, create_time, is_complete, is_delete from "ai_friend" where ai_friend_id=#{aiFriendId} and user_id=#{userId} and is_delete=false
